_help: Edit this file to change what the chat answers. Each rule has keywords (what the visitor might type) and replies (what is sent back, one bubble each). A keyword ending in * matches any ending (collab* matches collaborate, collaboration). action can be 'ig' (show the Instagram DM button) or 'copy_ig' (copy the visitor's message, then show the button). 'variants' are extra answers picked at random. 'packs' hold lookup answers (capitals, elements, glossary, and more). 'lists' hold jokes, facts, and so on.
